name: Riccardo Ferraro
source:
Riccardo Ferraro is a merchant and a gentleman of Venice who has lately taken up residence in London. Notable for his flamboyant airs and extraordinarily thick accent, Ferraro makes a fine addition to the melting pot that is late-16th century multi-cultural London.'

[From [url=https://www.astrologaster.com/]Official Website[/url]]
